Seems like we still try to access data on `base`, even though  it is null:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/65e73b3a5eec19e3269809b0f00e73a646723067/modules/gdscript/gdscript_compiler.cpp#L2807-L2810

~I have no real doubts that this code is problematic and leads to crashes. But I can't reproduce the crash with just the MRP and the steps from this issue 🤔~

Edit: Nvmd figured it out, had some non-default editor settings.
